geometry: All desktop and mobile Draco streams matched the baseline byte-for-byte; hashes are in detail-report.json.
method: Local in-app browser, 15-second requestAnimationFrame measurement. Baseline used its original committed model files and bundle. No physical-phone or production-network claim.
limitations: Measurements varied with local machine conditions and shader cache. No universal zero-regression guarantee.
Desktop first shader preparation was still 16.7 seconds in this run; mobile-profile 4-second readiness is not representative of every device.
The room captures are static floor-level reflection approximations, not parallax-correct mirrors or ray tracing.
Unbaked furniture uses vertex diffuse fixture lighting; direct sun and reflections remain per pixel.
Selective desktop detail increases texture memory and transfer size. Mobile material atlas resolution remains unchanged.
Visual equivalence to V-Ray or Unreal is not established.
